summary.text: Darrell Jackson is a Democrat from Richland County who represents Senate District 21 in the South Carolina Senate, where he has served since 1993, and is senior pastor of Bible Way Church of Atlas Road.

paragraphs.text: Jackson was born February 1, 1957, in Columbia, and graduated from Benedict College, where he was president of the Student Government Association, and from Columbia International University with an M.A.
Before the Senate he served on the Richland County School Board, District One, from 1990 to 1992.
His committee assignments are Banking and Insurance, Education, Ethics, Finance, Interstate Cooperation and Legislative Oversight.
